body.prose:
The prose of a brief is kept today as one piece of markdown, its parts placed by a link standing alone in a paragraph, a reading convention the store does not know. When glass can show its own files and history, prose is made native: a list of elements the store holds, each typed, the links among them references the store sees, and markdown only one way of saying it as text. None of it is built.

*The author's, 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05: Markdown is probably going to be replaced, and when it is, we're going native again; a standard native format for prose is what is truly agnostic, and the brief holds it and gives it its structure. The first build's markdown the session's, 2026-11-01.*
body.title: Prose made native
